features.title: Statics in the signature Type quick picks
features.description: When you add or edit a wormhole signature, the buttons next to Type now show this system's statics, marked with a dot. Click one to fill in the type and its destination class in one go; once Leads To is set, the matching static is listed first.

images.caption: Static quick picks in the signature dialog

features.title: What's New
features.description: Tripwire now tells you about new features after they're added. This window opens once after each update; reopen it any time from Settings > General Preferences > What's new.
